migrations.name: 001_initial_schema
migrations.description: PostgreSQL relational baseline generated from prisma/schema.prisma: native enums, tables, indexes and composite foreign keys. Immutable; future schema changes require new migrations.

migrations.name: 002_financial_invariants
migrations.description: Non-Prisma financial invariants: canonical decimal-string CHECKs, asset/custody domain + canonicality CHECKs, same-asset composite FK targets, sealed-journal + append-only triggers, deferred per-journal sum-zero/sealed/>=2-postings constraint trigger, AtomicAccount nonnegative-for-owner trigger, EconomicPolicy one-chip representability, FinancialIncident resolution consistency, TreasuryReconciliation amount canonicality. Immutable/append-only: never edit after release.

migrations.name: 003_audit_invariants
migrations.description: Append-only audit invariants: GameEvent and TournamentEvent immutability (no UPDATE; DELETE only via owning-row cascade), GameActionRequest one-way terminal transition with frozen identity/response, and re-assertion of the ordered/state-fingerprint unique indexes. Immutable/append-only: never edit after release.

migrations.name: 004_competitions
migrations.description: Generic competition provisioning (NONFINANCIAL/ASSET modes), explicit canonical atomic entry/prize terms with mode-consistency, zero-entry SERVICE entrants, reserved prize status and multi-credential SERVICE principals with operator-delegated orchestration. Immutable/append-only: never edit after release.
